searchText: Is EOF SFIed or DFIed? EOF is SFI for devnet 0/1 scope and CFI for devnet 2 scope Just concluded a research and PoC rust implementation I think y'all would love to explore; exploring the technical feasibility and performance implications of integrating the RISC-V instruction set architecture with the Ethereum Virtual Machine (EVM). The main goal was run Rust written smart contract, but haven't gotten there yet... Smart contract for the variant of the EVM is still rewritten in RISCV Assemble; https://x.com/developeruche/status/1913667336311132305 Please do reach out if stuffs like this interests you
